title: ContinuationReading
description: The output derive-continuation-reading.mjs writes: the held position echoed, each candidate's evidence rows echoed with citations alongside its metrologic-bilattice-joined aggregate charge and derived status, the overall reading, and the search terms echoed verbatim.

notFormal.description: Always true: this is a record-level continuation reading over evidence rows, never the unbuilt-affects note's held-⊥ formalization over playing-substrate chronicles; see the territorial-economy science seat's finding at lib/emsenn/services/561-group/services/science-services-section/services/social-science-services-section/services/economics-and-business-science-services-section/services/economics-science-services-section/services/territorial-economy-science-services-section/data/records/2026-09-05-continuation-reading-falsification-finding.json, which measured that formalization as unreachable over the playing substrate as built and named it upstream of this program.

aggregateCharge.description: The metrologic bilattice charge (@lenticule-science/metrologic/bilattice/charge) this candidate's evidence rows joined to via the knowledge-order join. `value` is the two-element [support, refutation] bilattice pair and `evidence` is the two-element [supportRowIds, refutationRowIds] lossless witness pair; both are encoded here as plain (non-tuple) arrays of length exactly 2, positional by convention, because the validator this schema is checked with (@red-cup-engineering/validate-json-service 0.1.0, pinning json-schema-services-section 0.1.11) does not implement the Draft 2020-12 `prefixItems` keyword (friction admitted 2026-09-06).
